  4222	            filteredText: filtered.text,
  4223	            parsed: parsed,
  4224	            generatedTokens: generatedTokens,
  4225	            truncatedAtSerialStop: truncated
  4226	        )
  4227	    }
  4228	
  4229	    /// SPEC-038 AC-6c: the batched streaming end, in the serial stream's
  4230	    /// order: remaining tool-call deltas and held-back content first, then
  4231	    /// the structured verdict on the buyer-visible text.
  4232	    static func finishContinuousBatchStream(
  4233	        _ finalized: ContinuousBatchFinalizedRow,
  4234	        state: AttachedPagedKVStreamState,
  4235	        request: ChatCompletionRequest,
  4236	        structuredAccumulator: StructuredStreamingContentAccumulator,
  4237	        idleState: StructuredStreamingIdleState,
  4238	        onChunk: (StreamChunk) -> Void
  4239	    ) throws -> CompletionResult {
  4240	        try state.finish(
  4241	            finalText: finalized.filteredText,
  4242	            parsed: finalized.parsed,
  4243	            structuredAccumulator: structuredAccumulator,
  4244	            idleState: idleState,
  4245	            onChunk: onChunk
  4246	        )
  4247	        return try validateStructuredStreamingCompletion(
  4248	            finalized.completion,
  4249	            request: request,
  4250	            buyerVisibleContent: structuredAccumulator.content
  4251	        )
  4252	    }
  4253	
  4254	    private func serialRouteCanaryCachedHitMissingRetainedHandoff(
  4255	        _ lease: ConversationCacheLease?,
  4256	        capability: ContinuousBatchingCapability,
  4257	        modelHasRecurrentLayers: Bool
  4258	    ) async throws -> Bool {
  4259	        guard let lease,
  4260	              let reason = Self.cachedHitFenceReason(
  4310	    /// AC-26 fence for a positive cached-token hit. It stays out of the
  4311	    /// scheduler unless the operator opted into `continuous_batching_cached_turns`,
  4312	    /// the lease carries a usable retained handoff, AND the accepted tuple
  4313	    /// covering this runtime records `cached_turns_accepted` (the per-tuple,
  4314	    /// revision-bound packaged proof). A retained handoff alone is capability,
  4315	    /// not authorization. Nil means the request may enter the scheduler.
  4316	    static func cachedHitFenceReason(
  4317	        mode: ContinuousBatchingMode,
  4318	        cachedPromptTokens: Int,
  4319	        hasRetainedPagedKVHandoff: Bool,
  4320	        cachedTurnsEnabled: Bool,
  4321	        cachedTurnsAccepted: Bool
  4322	    ) -> ContinuousBatchingUnsupportedReason? {
  4323	        guard mode != .off, cachedPromptTokens > 0 else { return nil }
  4324	        guard cachedTurnsEnabled, hasRetainedPagedKVHandoff else { return .stickyCacheHandoffUnavailable }
  4325	        return cachedTurnsAccepted ? nil : .cachedTurnsNotAccepted
  4326	    }
  4327	
  4328	    /// A hybrid retained delivery is resumable only from a recurrent checkpoint;
  4329	    /// one without any is discarded instead of committed as an entry no turn
  4330	    /// could resume (SPEC-038 AC-26).
  4331	    nonisolated static func retainedCacheIsCommittable(
  4332	        _ retainedCache: ContinuousBatchRetainedCache,
  4333	        modelHasRecurrentLayers: Bool
  4334	    ) -> Bool {
  4335	        !modelHasRecurrentLayers || !retainedCache.recurrentCheckpoints.isEmpty
  4336	    }
  4337	
  4338	    /// A retained paged-KV sequence, plus on a hybrid model the recurrent
  4339	    /// checkpoint at exactly the cached length (SPEC-038 AC-26).
  4340	    nonisolated static func leaseHasUsableRetainedHandoff(
  4341	        _ lease: ConversationCacheLease,
  4342	        modelHasRecurrentLayers: Bool
  4343	    ) -> Bool {
  4344	        guard lease.reusableCache?.retainedPagedKVSequence != nil else { return false }
  4345	        guard modelHasRecurrentLayers else { return true }
  4346	        return lease.recurrentCheckpoint?.tokenCount == lease.cachedPromptTokens
  4347	    }
  4348	
  4349	    /// The stored checkpoints a hybrid cached turn hands the scheduler: every
  4350	    /// one at or below the cached length (they are a prefix of this prompt).
  4351	    /// Empty unless the lease resumes a retained hybrid entry.
  4352	    nonisolated static func retainedRecurrentCheckpoints(
  4353	        for lease: ConversationCacheLease?
  4354	    ) -> [RecurrentStateCheckpoint] {
  4355	        guard let lease,
  4356	              lease.recurrentCheckpoint != nil,
  4357	              let reusable = lease.reusableCache,
  4358	              reusable.retainedPagedKVSequence != nil
  4359	        else { return [] }
  4360	        return reusable.recurrentCheckpoints.filter { $0.tokenCount <= lease.cachedPromptTokens }
  4361	    }

  4363	    private func attachedContinuousBatchCompletion(
  4364	        request: ChatCompletionRequest,
  4365	        snapshot: RuntimeSnapshot,
  4366	        capability: ContinuousBatchingCapability,
  4367	        completionStartedAt: Date,
  4368	        shouldCancel: @escaping @Sendable () -> Bool,
  4369	        drainCancelled: DrainCancelToken
  4370	    ) async throws -> CompletionResult? {
  4371	        guard capability.isRequested,
  4372	              capability.unsupportedReason == nil,
  4373	              !capability.shouldUseSerialPath,
  4374	              case .attached = pagedKVAttachDecision
  4375	        else {
  4376	            return nil
  4377	        }
  4378	        guard let scheduler = continuousBatchScheduler else {
  4379	            throw Self.attachedPagedKVUnavailableError(code: "continuous_batching_scheduler_unavailable")
  4380	        }
  4381	        guard let schedulerRequestID = Self.schedulerRequestID(for: request) else {
  4382	            throw Self.attachedPagedKVUnavailableError(code: ContinuousBatchingUnsupportedReason.stableRequestIDUnavailable.apiCode)
  4383	        }
  4384	        guard let container = snapshot.container else {
  4385	            throw APIError(status: 503, message: "Model not loaded", type: "server_error", code: "model_not_loaded")
  4386	        }
  4387	
  4388	        let maxContextTokens = maxContextTokens
  4389	        let stopTokenFilter = stopTokenFilter
  4390	        let templateSupportsThinkingToggle = snapshot.templateSupportsThinkingToggle
  4391	        CBTrace.log(schedulerRequestID, "rt_cb_prepare")
  4392	        let (prepared, detokenizer) = try await container.perform { context -> (ContinuousBatchPreparedRequest, StreamingDetokenizer) in
  4393	            try drainCancelled.check()
  4394	            try Task.checkCancellation()
  4395	            let input = try Self.userInput(
  4396	                for: request,
  4397	                templateSupportsThinkingToggle: templateSupportsThinkingToggle
  4398	            )
  4399	            let lmInput = try await context.processor.prepare(input: input)
  4400	            let promptTokens = lmInput.text.tokens.asArray(Int32.self).map(Int.init)
  4401	            try Self.validatePromptTokenCount(promptTokens.count, maxContextTokens: maxContextTokens)
  4402	            let stopTokenSequences = Self.continuousBatchStopTokenSequences(
  4403	                requestStops: request.stop,
  4404	                context: context
  4405	            )
  4406	            let tokenizer = context.tokenizer
  4407	            // Only keyed requests can hold or reuse conversation state.
  4408	            let hybrid = Self.nonEmpty(request.conversationKey) != nil
  4409	                && ConversationCacheLayers.hasRecurrentLayers(context.model.newCache(parameters: nil))
  4410	            return (
  4411	                ContinuousBatchPreparedRequest(
  4412	                    promptTokens: promptTokens,
  4413	                    stopTokenSequences: stopTokenSequences,
  4414	                    modelStopTokenIDs: Self.generationStopTokenIDs(
  4415	                        for: Self.harmonyTerminalPreservingContext(from: context, modelID: request.model)
  4416	                    ),
  4417	                    recurrentCheckpointPositions: Self.continuousBatchRecurrentCheckpointPositions(
  4418	                        promptTokens: promptTokens,
  4419	                        conversationKey: request.conversationKey,
  4420	                        hybrid: hybrid,
  4421	                        context: context
  4422	                    ),
  4423	                    modelHasRecurrentLayers: hybrid
  4424	                ),
  4425	                StreamingDetokenizer { tokenizer.decode(tokenIds: $0) }
  4426	            )
  4427	        }
  4428	
  4429	        try drainCancelled.check()
  4430	        try Task.checkCancellation()
  4431	        if shouldCancel() { throw CancellationError() }
  4432	        let maxOutputTokens = request.maxTokens ?? max(1, maxContextTokens - prepared.promptTokens.count)
  4433	        let preparedPromptTokenIDs = prepared.promptTokens.map(Int32.init)
  4434	        let batchKVBits = Self.effectiveKVBits(
  4435	            configured: kvBitsOverride,
  4436	            conversationKey: request.conversationKey
  4437	        )
  4438	        let lease = await conversationCache.begin(
  4439	            conversationKey: request.conversationKey,
  4440	            incomingTokens: preparedPromptTokenIDs,
  4441	            modelID: request.model,
  4442	            kvBits: batchKVBits,
  4443	            allowRetainedPagedKVHandoff: true
  4444	        )
  4445	        CBTrace.log(schedulerRequestID, "rt_cb_lease cached=\(lease?.cachedPromptTokens ?? -1)")
  4446	        if try await serialRouteCanaryCachedHitMissingRetainedHandoff(
  4447	            lease,
  4448	            capability: capability,
  4449	            modelHasRecurrentLayers: prepared.modelHasRecurrentLayers
  4450	        ) {
  4451	            return nil
  4452	        }
  4453	        // SPEC-038 AC-6c: a serial tool turn stops where the serial path
  4454	        // stops generating (its first complete valid tool call).
  4455	        let serialToolStop = Self.serialToolStopApplies(request)
  4456	            ? ContinuousBatchSerialToolStopState(request: request)
  4457	            : nil
  4458	        let requestStops = request.stop
  4459	        let result: ContinuousBatchSchedulerResult
  4460	        do {
  4461	            CBTrace.log(schedulerRequestID, "rt_cb_submit")
  4462	            result = try await Self.withDrainAndClientCancellation(drainCancelled, shouldCancel: shouldCancel) {
  4463	                try await scheduler.submit(ContinuousBatchSchedulerRequest(
  4464	                    id: schedulerRequestID,
  4465	                    conversationKey: request.conversationKey ?? "",
  4466	                    promptTokens: prepared.promptTokens,
  4467	                    maxOutputTokens: maxOutputTokens,
  4468	                    stopTokenSequences: prepared.stopTokenSequences,
  4469	                    samplerSeed: ContinuousBatchRowSampler.requestSeed(requestID: schedulerRequestID),
  4470	                    temperature: request.temperature,
  4471	                    topP: request.topP,
  4472	                    presencePenalty: request.presencePenalty,
  4473	                    frequencyPenalty: request.frequencyPenalty,
  4474	                    cachedPromptTokens: lease?.cachedPromptTokens ?? 0,
  4475	                    retainedPagedKVSequence: lease?.reusableCache?.retainedPagedKVSequence,
  4476	                    recurrentCheckpointPositions: prepared.recurrentCheckpointPositions,
  4477	                    retainedRecurrentCheckpoints: Self.retainedRecurrentCheckpoints(for: lease)
  4478	                ), tokenSink: { event in
  4479	                    guard let serialToolStop else { return }
  4480	                    if serialToolStop.observe(
  4481	                        eventTokens: event.replayTokens ?? [event.token],
  4482	                        decode: detokenizer.decode,
  4483	                        stopTokenFilter: stopTokenFilter,
  4484	                        requestStops: requestStops
  4485	                    ) {
  4486	                        Task { await scheduler.stopEarly(requestID: schedulerRequestID) }
  4487	                    }
  4488	                })
  4489	            }
  4490	        } catch {
  4491	            if let lease {
  4492	                await conversationCache.abort(lease)
  4493	            }
  4494	            // SPEC-038 AC-25: one shared scheduler-error map, so the
  4495	            // non-streaming and streaming paths cannot drift.
  4496	            CBTrace.log(schedulerRequestID, "rt_cb_threw \(type(of: error))")
  4497	            throw (error as? ContinuousBatchSchedulerError)?.asAPIError() ?? error
  4498	        }
  4499	        CBTrace.log(schedulerRequestID, "rt_cb_returned status=\(result.terminalStatus)")
  4500	        do {
  4501	            try drainCancelled.check()
  4502	            try Task.checkCancellation()
  4503	            if shouldCancel() { throw CancellationError() }
  4504	            guard result.terminalStatus == .stop || result.terminalStatus == .length else {
  4505	                throw Self.terminalFailureError(code: result.errorCode ?? "continuous_batching_request_failed")
  4506	            }
  4507	            let completionEndedAt = Date()
  4508	            let finalized = try await container.perform { context in
  4509	                try Self.finalizeContinuousBatchRow(
  4510	                    request: request,
  4511	                    result: result,
  4512	                    modelStopTokenIDs: prepared.modelStopTokenIDs,
  4513	                    promptTokenIDs: preparedPromptTokenIDs,
  4514	                    decode: { context.tokenizer.decode(tokenIds: $0) },
  4515	                    stopTokenFilter: stopTokenFilter,
  4516	                    generationMilliseconds: Int64(completionEndedAt.timeIntervalSince(completionStartedAt) * 1000),
  4517	                    modelHash: snapshot.modelHash
  4518	                )
  4519	            }
  4520	            let completion = try Self.validateStructuredCompletion(finalized.completion, request: request)
  4521	            let generatedTokens = finalized.generatedTokens
  4522	            if !finalized.truncatedAtSerialStop,
  4523	               let lease, let retainedCache = result.retainedCache,
  4524	               Self.retainedCacheIsCommittable(
  4525	                   retainedCache,
  4526	                   modelHasRecurrentLayers: prepared.modelHasRecurrentLayers
  4527	               ) {
  4528	                await conversationCache.commit(
  4529	                    lease,
  4530	                    cache: ConversationCacheLayers(
  4531	                        retainedCache.layers,
  4532	                        retainedPagedKVSequence: retainedCache.retainedSequence,
  4533	                        discardRetainedPagedKVSequence: { retained, key in
  4534	                            await scheduler.discardRetainedCache(retained, conversationKey: key)
  4535	                        },
  4536	                        recurrentCheckpoints: retainedCache.recurrentCheckpoints
  4537	                    ),
  4538	                    fullTokens: preparedPromptTokenIDs + generatedTokens.map(Int32.init)
  4539	                )
  4540	                await scheduler.acknowledgeRetainedCacheDelivery(retainedCache)
  4541	            } else if !finalized.truncatedAtSerialStop,
  4542	                      let lease, let serialCache = result.serialConversationCache,
  4543	                      let fullTokens = Self.serialConversationCacheCommitTokens(
  4544	                          canonicalTokens: preparedPromptTokenIDs + generatedTokens.map(Int32.init),
  4545	                          coveredTokenCount: serialCache.tokenCount
  4546	                      ) {
  4547	                // SPEC-038 FR-CB4 hybrid first turn: the next keyed turn serial-
  4548	                // routes (AC-26) and reuses this entry from its checkpoints.
  4549	                await conversationCache.commit(
  4550	                    lease,
  4551	                    cache: ConversationCacheLayers(
  4552	                        serialCache.layers,
  4553	                        recurrentCheckpoints: serialCache.recurrentCheckpoints
  4554	                    ),
  4555	                    fullTokens: fullTokens
  4556	                )
  4557	            } else if let retainedCache = result.retainedCache {
  4558	                await scheduler.cancelRetainedCacheDelivery(
  4559	                    retainedCache,
  4560	                    conversationKey: result.conversationKey
  4561	                )
  4562	                if let lease {
  4563	                    await conversationCache.abort(lease)
  4564	                }
  4565	            } else if let lease {
  4566	                await conversationCache.abort(lease)
  4567	            }
  4568	            return completion
  4569	        } catch {
  4570	            if let retainedCache = result.retainedCache {
  4571	                await scheduler.cancelRetainedCacheDelivery(
  4572	                    retainedCache,
  4573	                    conversationKey: result.conversationKey
  4574	                )
  4575	            }
  4576	            if let lease {
  4577	                await conversationCache.abort(lease)
  4578	            }
  4579	            throw error
  4580	        }
  4581	    }

  4583	    nonisolated static func schedulerRequestID(for request: ChatCompletionRequest) -> String? {
  4584	        nonEmpty(request.requestID)

  7577	/// The serial streaming path's buyer-visible text step for non-Harmony output:
  7578	/// incremental tool-call deltas (SPEC-018), assistant-content suppression once
  7579	/// a tool call opens, the SPEC-019 structured-content accumulator, and the
  7580	/// serial-tool-turn stop. The serial `stream` path and the continuous-batching
  7581	/// stream sink (SPEC-038 AC-6c) both drive this one type, so a batched
  7582	/// tool-bearing or structured-output row emits the serial SSE sequence.
  7583	struct SerialStreamingTextEmitter {
  7584	    enum Step: Equatable {
  7585	        case more
  7586	        /// A buyer `stop` string matched in the decoded text.
  7587	        case requestStop
  7588	        /// A serial tool turn completed its first valid tool call.
  7589	        case toolCallComplete
  7590	        /// The structured-output accumulator refused the delta (its error is
  7591	        /// held by the accumulator).
  7592	        case structuredError
  7593	    }
  7594	
  7595	    private let streamToolsIncrementally: Bool
  7596	    private let stopsAfterFirstCompleteToolCall: Bool
  7597	    private var toolStreamer: NativeToolCallStreamEmitter
  7598	    private(set) var emittedText = ""
  7599	
  7600	    init(request: ChatCompletionRequest) {
  7601	        streamToolsIncrementally = ModelRuntime.hasEnabledTools(request.promptSource.tools)
  7602	            && !HarmonyResponseParser.isHarmonyModelID(request.model)
  7603	        stopsAfterFirstCompleteToolCall = request.stopsAfterFirstCompleteToolCall
  7604	        toolStreamer = NativeToolCallStreamEmitter(
  7605	            modelID: request.model,
  7606	            allowedFunctionNames: ModelRuntime.toolFunctionNames(from: request.promptSource.tools)
  7607	        )
  7608	    }
  7609	
  7610	    /// One decoded prefix of the generation (`streamingSafePrefix` of every
  7611	    /// token so far).
  7612	    mutating func step(
  7613	        candidate: (text: String, hitStop: Bool),
  7614	        structuredAccumulator: StructuredStreamingContentAccumulator,
  7615	        idleState: StructuredStreamingIdleState,
  7616	        onChunk: (StreamChunk) -> Void
  7617	    ) -> Step {
  7618	        if streamToolsIncrementally {
  7619	            for event in toolStreamer.observe(candidate.text) {
  7620	                onChunk(event)
  7621	            }
  7622	            if !toolStreamer.suppressesAssistantContent {
  7623	                let safe = toolStreamer.visibleContentPrefix(of: candidate.text)
  7624	                let delta = ModelRuntime.streamDelta(from: emittedText, to: safe)
  7625	                if !delta.isEmpty {
  7626	                    if structuredAccumulator.append(delta) != nil {
  7627	                        return .structuredError
  7628	                    }
  7629	                    idleState.noteContent()
  7630	                    emittedText = safe
  7631	                    onChunk(.content(delta))
  7632	                }
  7633	            }
  7634	            if stopsAfterFirstCompleteToolCall, toolStreamer.hasCompletedValidToolCall {
  7635	                return .toolCallComplete
  7636	            }
  7637	            return candidate.hitStop ? .requestStop : .more
  7638	        }
  7639	
  7640	        let delta = ModelRuntime.streamDelta(from: emittedText, to: candidate.text)
  7641	        if !delta.isEmpty {
  7642	            if structuredAccumulator.append(delta) != nil {
  7643	                return .structuredError
  7644	            }
  7645	            idleState.noteContent()
  7646	            emittedText = candidate.text
  7647	            onChunk(.content(delta))
  7648	        }
  7649	        return candidate.hitStop ? .requestStop : .more
  7650	    }
  7651	
  7652	    /// The end of generation: remaining tool-call deltas over the final
  7653	    /// filtered text, then any content the stream held back.
  7654	    mutating func finish(
  7655	        finalText: String,
  7656	        parsed: ModelRuntime.ParsedGeneratedOutput,
  7657	        structuredAccumulator: StructuredStreamingContentAccumulator,
  7658	        idleState: StructuredStreamingIdleState,
  7659	        onChunk: (StreamChunk) -> Void
  7660	    ) throws {
  7661	        let finalDelta = ModelRuntime.streamDelta(from: emittedText, to: parsed.content)
  7662	        if streamToolsIncrementally {
  7663	            for event in toolStreamer.observe(finalText) {
  7664	                onChunk(event)
  7665	            }
  7666	            if parsed.toolCalls.isEmpty,
  7667	               !parsed.content.isEmpty,
  7668	               !toolStreamer.suppressesAssistantContent
  7669	            {
  7670	                let contentDelta = ModelRuntime.streamDelta(from: emittedText, to: parsed.content)
  7671	                if !contentDelta.isEmpty {
  7672	                    if let error = structuredAccumulator.append(contentDelta) {
  7673	                        throw error
  7674	                    }
  7675	                    idleState.noteContent()
  7676	                    onChunk(.content(contentDelta))
  7677	                }
  7678	            }
  7679	        } else if !finalDelta.isEmpty {
  7680	            if let error = structuredAccumulator.append(finalDelta) {
  7681	                throw error
  7682	            }
  7683	            idleState.noteContent()
  7684	            onChunk(.content(finalDelta))
  7685	        }
  7686	        if let error = structuredAccumulator.error {
  7687	            throw error
  7688	        }
  7689	    }
  7690	}
  7691	
  7692	// `internal` (not `private`) so the allowlist fail-closed behavior is unit-testable via
  7693	// `@testable import macprovider_cli` (see NativeToolCallStreamEmitterTests).
  7694	struct NativeToolCallStreamEmitter {
  7695	    private let startDelimiter: String
  7696	    private let endDelimiter: String
  7697	    private let argumentKey: String
  7698	    /// Declared tools for this request. A streamed tool-call delta MUST NOT be emitted for
  7699	    /// any function name not in this set — otherwise a widened name grammar could surface an
  7700	    /// undeclared tool_call to the buyer before the final parser's fail-closed check
  7701	    /// (SPEC-018 §3.5). `nil`/empty means no tools were declared, so nothing may be emitted.
  7702	    private let allowedFunctionNames: Set<String>?
  7703	    /// Function-XML (`<function=…>`) is a Qwen-row-only grammar (SPEC-018 §3.1 v0.2.7). The
  7704	    /// streaming emitter mirrors the non-streaming parser's family gate: only Qwen models may
  7705	    /// stream `<function=…>` tool-call deltas; other families fall through to JSON parsing (which
  7706	    /// yields nothing for XML), so no non-Qwen family can stream a function-XML delta.
  7707	    private let allowsFunctionXML: Bool
  7708	    /// SPEC-018 §3.2: only Qwen 2.5/3 and Llama 3.3 native grammars are recognized.
  7709	    /// Unsupported families must not complete a serial stop on lookalike markup.
  7710	    private let enabled: Bool
  7711	    private var sawToolDelimiter = false
  7712	    private var opened = false
  7713	    private var closed = false
  7714	    private var completedValidToolCall = false
  7715	    private var emittedArguments = ""
  7716	    private var callID = "call_\(UUID().uuidString.replacingOccurrences(of: "-", with: "").lowercased())"
  7717	
  7718	    init(modelID: String, allowedFunctionNames: Set<String>?) {
  7719	        self.allowedFunctionNames = allowedFunctionNames
  7720	        let isQwen = modelID.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains("qwen2.5")
  7721	            || modelID.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains("qwen3")
  7722	        let isLlama33 = modelID.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains("llama-3.3")
  7723	        self.enabled = isQwen || isLlama33
  7724	        self.allowsFunctionXML = isQwen
  7725	        if isLlama33 {
  7726	            startDelimiter = "<|python_tag|>"
  7727	            endDelimiter = "<|eom_id|>"
  7728	            argumentKey = "parameters"
  7729	        } else {
  7730	            startDelimiter = "<tool_call>"
  7731	            endDelimiter = "</tool_call>"
  7732	            argumentKey = "arguments"
  7733	        }
  7734	    }
  7735	
  7736	    var suppressesAssistantContent: Bool { enabled && (opened || sawToolDelimiter) }
  7737	
  7738	    /// True once a declared tool has parser-valid, within-cap arguments (complete
  7739	    /// JSON object or closed function-XML). Wrapper-close, prefixes, and cap
  7740	    /// failures must not satisfy this; they must not stop a serial turn.
  7741	    var hasCompletedValidToolCall: Bool { completedValidToolCall }
  7742	
  7743	    func visibleContentPrefix(of text: String) -> String {
  7744	        guard enabled else { return text }
  7745	        if suppressesAssistantContent {
  7746	            return ""
  7747	        }
  7748	        if let start = text.range(of: startDelimiter) {
  7749	            return String(text[..<start.lowerBound])
  7750	        }
  7751	        if allowsFunctionXML, let start = text.range(of: "<function=") {
  7752	            return String(text[..<start.lowerBound])
  7753	        }
  7754	        return Self.stripIncompleteOpenDelimiter(from: text, delimiter: startDelimiter, extra: allowsFunctionXML ? "<function=" : nil)
  7755	    }
  7756	
  7757	    mutating func observe(_ text: String) -> [StreamChunk] {
  7758	        guard enabled, !closed else {
  7759	            return []
  7760	        }
  7761	        if let start = text.range(of: startDelimiter) {
  7762	            sawToolDelimiter = true
  7763	            let afterStart = start.upperBound
  7764	            let bodyEnd = text.range(of: endDelimiter, range: afterStart..<text.endIndex)?.lowerBound ?? text.endIndex
  7765	            let body = String(text[afterStart..<bodyEnd])
  7766	            var isClosed = text.range(of: endDelimiter, range: afterStart..<text.endIndex) != nil
  7767	            if allowsFunctionXML, body.contains("<function=") {
  7768	                // Outer </tool_call> is not a valid XML close; wait for </function>.
  7769	                return observeNemotronXML(body: body, isClosed: body.contains("</function>"))
  7770	            }
  7771	            if !isClosed, ToolCallParser.firstCompleteJSONObject(in: body) != nil {
  7772	                isClosed = true
  7773	            }
  7774	            return observeJSONToolCall(body: body, isClosed: isClosed)
  7775	        }
  7776	        if allowsFunctionXML, text.contains("<function=") {
  7777	            sawToolDelimiter = true
  7778	            let isClosed = text.contains("</function>")
  7779	            return observeNemotronXML(body: text, isClosed: isClosed)
  7780	        }
  7781	        return []
  7782	    }
  7783	
  7784	    private mutating func observeJSONToolCall(body: String, isClosed: Bool) -> [StreamChunk] {
  7785	        let name: String
  7786	        let arguments: String
  7787	        let parsedComplete: Bool
  7788	        if let object = ToolCallParser.firstCompleteJSONObject(in: body),
  7789	           let parsed = ToolCallParser.jsonToolCallNameAndArguments(in: object, argumentKey: argumentKey)
  7790	        {

  3218	    private func validatedRetainedTokenCost(
  3219	        for request: ContinuousBatchSchedulerRequest
  3220	    ) -> Int? {
  3221	        guard request.maxOutputTokens <= configuration.maxRequestTokens else { return nil }
  3222	        let (contextTokens, contextOverflow) = request.promptTokens.count.addingReportingOverflow(
  3223	            request.maxOutputTokens
  3224	        )
  3225	        guard !contextOverflow, contextTokens <= configuration.maxRequestTokens else { return nil }
  3226	        var stopTokens = 0
  3227	        for sequence in request.stopTokenSequences {
  3228	            let (next, overflow) = stopTokens.addingReportingOverflow(sequence.count)
  3229	            guard !overflow, next <= configuration.maxTotalStopTokens else { return nil }
  3230	            stopTokens = next
  3231	        }
  3232	        let (retained, retainedOverflow) = request.promptTokens.count.addingReportingOverflow(stopTokens)
  3233	        guard !retainedOverflow else { return nil }
  3234	        return retained
  3235	    }

  3237	    private func queueHasCapacity(addingTokenCost tokenCost: Int) -> Bool {
  3238	        let (queuedCount, countOverflow) = waiting.count.addingReportingOverflow(pendingBindingChecks)
  3239	        guard !countOverflow, queuedCount < configuration.queueLimit else { return false }
  3240	        var waitingTokens = 0
  3241	        for request in waiting {
  3242	            guard let cost = validatedRetainedTokenCost(for: request) else { return false }
  3243	            let (next, overflow) = waitingTokens.addingReportingOverflow(cost)
  3244	            guard !overflow else { return false }
  3245	            waitingTokens = next
  3246	        }
  3247	        let (withPending, pendingOverflow) = waitingTokens.addingReportingOverflow(
  3248	            pendingBindingTokenCount
  3249	        )
  3250	        guard !pendingOverflow else { return false }
  3251	        let (total, totalOverflow) = withPending.addingReportingOverflow(tokenCost)
  3252	        return !totalOverflow && total <= configuration.maxQueuedTokens
  3253	    }

  3255	    private func isPotentialStopPrefix(_ pending: [Int], stopSequences: [[Int]]) -> Bool {
  3256	        stopSequences.contains { sequence in
  3257	            pending.count <= sequence.count && Array(sequence.prefix(pending.count)) == pending
  3258	        }

  2332	    private func deliverVisibleTokens(_ tokens: [Int], firstIndex: Int, row: Row) -> Bool {
  2333	        guard !tokens.isEmpty else { return !(requestWaiters[row.request.id]?.isEmpty ?? true) }

  2335	            let event = ContinuousBatchSchedulerTokenEvent(
  2336	                requestID: row.request.id,
  2337	                tokenIndex: firstIndex + offset,
  2338	                token: token,
  2339	                replayTokens: nil,
  2340	                snapshot: row.snapshot
  2341	            )
  2342	            var retained: [Waiter] = []
  2343	            for waiter in requestWaiters[row.request.id] ?? [] {
  2344	                if waiter.delivery.offer(event) {
  2345	                    retained.append(waiter)
  2346	                } else {
  2347	                    beginStoppingActiveWaiter(
  2348	                        requestID: row.request.id,
  2349	                        waiter: waiter,
  2350	                        error: ContinuousBatchSchedulerError.deliveryBackpressure
  2351	                    )
  2352	                }
  2353	            }
  2354	            if retained.isEmpty {
  2355	                requestWaiters.removeValue(forKey: row.request.id)
  2356	                return false
  2357	            }
  2358	            requestWaiters[row.request.id] = retained
  2359	        }
  2360	        return true
  2361	    }

   210	                    settlementDisposition: .eligibleOwner
   211	                ),
   212	                request: request,
   213	                buyerVisibleContent: accumulator.content
   214	            )
   215	            return (sink.normalized(), .success(completion))
   216	        } catch {
   217	            return (sink.normalized(), .failure(error as! APIError))
   218	        }
   219	    }
   220	
   221	    /// The batched stream: every delivered token goes through the row's
   222	    /// stream state (tokens past the serial stop point included, as a row
   223	    /// may decode on before `stopEarly` lands), then the batched finalize.
   224	    private func batchedStream(
   225	        _ request: ChatCompletionRequest,
   226	        vocab: Vocab,
   227	        deliveryEvents: [[Int]]? = nil,
   228	        status: ContinuousBatchSchedulerTerminalStatus = .stop
   229	    ) -> (chunks: [String], result: Result<CompletionResult, APIError>, stopRequests: Int, finalized: ModelRuntime.ContinuousBatchFinalizedRow?) {
   230	        let accumulator = StructuredStreamingContentAccumulator(
   231	            enabled: ModelRuntime.requiresStructuredValidation(request.responseFormat)
   232	        )
   233	        let idle = StructuredStreamingIdleState(enabled: false)
   234	        let sink = ChunkSink()
   235	        let state = ModelRuntime.AttachedPagedKVStreamState(request: request)
   236	        let events = deliveryEvents ?? vocab.ids.map { [$0] }
   237	        var stopRequests = 0
   238	        for event in events {
   239	            if state.step(
   240	                eventTokens: event,
   241	                decode: vocab.decode,
   242	                stopTokenFilter: Self.stopTokenFilter,
   243	                requestStops: request.stop,
   244	                structuredAccumulator: accumulator,
   245	                idleState: idle,
   246	                onChunk: sink.append
   247	            ) {
   248	                stopRequests += 1
   249	            }
   250	        }
   251	        if let error = state.error() {
   252	            return (sink.normalized(), .failure(error), stopRequests, nil)
   253	        }
   254	        do {
   255	            let finalized = try finalizeBatched(
   256	                request,
   257	                vocab: vocab,
   258	                ids: vocab.ids,
   259	                status: status
   260	            )
   260	            )
   261	            if !state.hasObservedTokens {
   262	                _ = state.step(
   263	                    eventTokens: finalized.generatedTokens,
   264	                    decode: vocab.decode,
   265	                    stopTokenFilter: Self.stopTokenFilter,
   266	                    requestStops: request.stop,
   267	                    structuredAccumulator: accumulator,
   268	                    idleState: idle,
   269	                    onChunk: sink.append
   270	                )
   271	            }
   272	            let completion = try ModelRuntime.finishContinuousBatchStream(
   273	                finalized,
   274	                state: state,
   275	                request: request,
   276	                structuredAccumulator: accumulator,
   277	                idleState: idle,
   278	                onChunk: sink.append
   279	            )
   280	            return (sink.normalized(), .success(completion), stopRequests, finalized)
   281	        } catch {
   282	            return (sink.normalized(), .failure(error as! APIError), stopRequests, nil)
   283	        }
   284	    }

   286	    private func calls(_ toolCalls: [macprovider_cli.ToolCall]?) -> [String] {
   287	        (toolCalls ?? []).map { "\($0.functionName) \($0.arguments)" }
   288	    }

   292	    func testSerialToolTurnTruncatesToSerialStopAndMatchesSerialToolCalls() throws {
   293	        let request = try request(["tools": Self.weatherTool])
   294	        let vocab = Vocab(pieces: Self.twoCallPieces)
   295	        let serial = try serialComplete(request, vocab: vocab)
   296	        XCTAssertLessThan(serial.tokenCount, vocab.pieces.count, "serial stops at the first complete call")
   297	
   298	        // The batched row's sink runs the serial stop test on each token.
   299	        let stop = ModelRuntime.ContinuousBatchSerialToolStopState(request: request)
   300	        var stopRequests = 0
   301	        for id in vocab.ids where stop.observe(
   302	            eventTokens: [id],
   303	            decode: vocab.decode,
   304	            stopTokenFilter: Self.stopTokenFilter,
   305	            requestStops: request.stop
   306	        ) {
   307	            stopRequests += 1
   308	        }
   309	        XCTAssertEqual(stopRequests, 1)
   310	        XCTAssertEqual(stop.stopTokenCount, serial.tokenCount)
   311	
   312	        // The row decoded every token before stopping; the finalize truncates.
   313	        let batched = try finalizeBatched(
   314	            request,
   315	            vocab: vocab,
   316	            ids: vocab.ids,
   317	            status: .length
   318	        )
   319	        let completion = try ModelRuntime.validateStructuredCompletion(batched.completion, request: request)
   320	        XCTAssertEqual(calls(completion.toolCalls), calls(serial.completion.toolCalls))
   321	        XCTAssertEqual(calls(completion.toolCalls), [#"get_weather {"city":"Paris"}"#])
   322	        XCTAssertEqual(completion.finishReason, "tool_calls")
   323	        XCTAssertEqual(completion.content, serial.completion.content)
   324	        XCTAssertEqual(completion.completionTokens, serial.completion.completionTokens)
   325	        XCTAssertEqual(completion.completionTokens, serial.tokenCount)
   326	        XCTAssertEqual(batched.generatedTokens, Array(vocab.ids.prefix(serial.tokenCount)))
   327	        XCTAssertTrue(batched.truncatedAtSerialStop, "a row past the stop point must not commit its cache")
   328	    }

   571	    private static func apiCode(_ body: () throws -> Void) -> String? {
   572	        do {
   573	            try body()
   574	            return nil
   575	        } catch let error as APIError {
   576	            return error.code
   577	        } catch {
   578	            return "non_api_error:\(error)"
   579	        }
   580	    }
   581	}
   582	
   583	/// Normalized SSE-relevant chunks: tool-call ids are random per emitter, so
   584	/// the first delta records only its function name.
   585	private final class ChunkSink: @unchecked Sendable {
   586	    private let lock = NSLock()
   587	    private var chunks: [StreamChunk] = []
   588	
   589	    func append(_ chunk: StreamChunk) {
   590	        lock.lock()
   591	        chunks.append(chunk)
   592	        lock.unlock()
   593	    }
   594	
   595	    func normalized() -> [String] {
   596	        lock.lock()
   597	        defer { lock.unlock() }
   598	        return chunks.map { chunk in
   599	            switch chunk {
   600	            case .content(let text):
   601	                return "content:\(text)"
   602	            case .toolCallDelta(let delta):
   603	                if let name = delta.functionName {
   604	                    return "tool:\(name):\(delta.arguments ?? "")"
   605	                }
   606	                return "args:\(delta.index):\(delta.arguments ?? "")"
   607	            }
   608	        }
   609	    }
   610	}

  7537	    private func stringField(_ key: String, in body: String) -> String? {
  7538	        guard let keyRange = body.range(of: "\"\(key)\""),
  7539	              let colon = body.range(of: ":", range: keyRange.upperBound..<body.endIndex)
  7540	        else {
  7541	            return nil
  7542	        }
  7543	        var index = colon.upperBound
  7544	        while index < body.endIndex, body[index].isWhitespace {
  7545	            index = body.index(after: index)
  7546	        }
  7547	        guard index < body.endIndex, body[index] == "\"" else {
  7548	            return nil
  7549	        }
  7550	        index = body.index(after: index)
  7551	        var value = ""
  7552	        var escaped = false
  7553	        while index < body.endIndex {
  7554	            let ch = body[index]
  7555	            if escaped {
  7556	                value.append(ch)
  7557	                escaped = false
  7558	            } else if ch == "\\" {
  7559	                escaped = true
  7560	            } else if ch == "\"" {
  7561	                return value
  7562	            } else {
  7563	                value.append(ch)
  7564	            }
  7565	            index = body.index(after: index)
  7566	        }
  7567	        return nil
  7568	    }

  7570	    private static func stripIncompleteOpenDelimiter(from text: String, delimiter: String, extra: String?) -> String {
  7571	        var candidates = [delimiter]
  7572	        if let extra {
  7573	            candidates.append(extra)
  7574	        }
  7575	        var longest = 0
  7576	        for candidate in candidates {
  7577	            let prefixes = (1..<candidate.count).map { String(candidate.prefix($0)) }
  7578	            for prefix in prefixes where text.hasSuffix(prefix) {
  7579	                longest = max(longest, prefix.count)
  7580	            }
  7581	        }
  7582	        guard longest > 0 else {
  7583	            return text
  7584	        }
  7585	        return String(text.dropLast(longest))
  7586	    }
  7587	
  7588	    private static func delta(from old: String, to new: String) -> String {
  7589	        guard new.hasPrefix(old) else {
  7590	            // A replacement that is not a prefix is not concat-safe on the OpenAI
  7591	            // wire (`{}` + `{"command":...}`). Skip rather than emit a second object.
  7592	            return ""
  7593	        }
  7594	        return String(new.dropFirst(old.count))
  7595	    }
  7596	}

  7598	final class DrainCancelToken: @unchecked Sendable {
  7599	    private var _fired = false
  7600	    private var waiters: [UUID: CheckedContinuation<Void, Never>] = [:]
  7601	    private let lock = NSLock()
  7602	
  7603	    var isFired: Bool {
  7604	        lock.lock()
  7605	        defer { lock.unlock() }
  7606	        return _fired
  7607	    }
  7608	
  7609	    func check() throws {
  7610	        if isFired {
  7611	            throw DrainCancelledError()
  7612	        }
  7613	    }
  7614	
  7615	    func fire() {
  7616	        let continuations: [CheckedContinuation<Void, Never>]
  7617	        lock.lock()
  7618	        if _fired {
  7619	            lock.unlock()
  7620	            return
  7621	        }
  7622	        _fired = true
  7623	        continuations = Array(waiters.values)
  7624	        waiters.removeAll()
  7625	        lock.unlock()
  7626	
  7627	        for continuation in continuations {
  7628	            continuation.resume()
  7629	        }
  7630	    }
  7631	
  7632	    func waitUntilFired() async {
  7633	        if isFired {
  7634	            return
  7635	        }
  7636	        await withCheckedContinuation { (continuation: CheckedContinuation<Void, Never>) in
  7637	            var shouldResume = false
  7638	            let id = UUID()
  7639	            lock.lock()
  7640	            if _fired {
  7641	                shouldResume = true
  7642	            } else {
  7643	                waiters[id] = continuation
  7644	            }
  7645	            lock.unlock()
  7646	
  7647	            if shouldResume {
  7648	                continuation.resume()
  7649	            }
  7650	        }
  7651	    }
  7652	}

     }

     /// preserves JSON `null` as `.null`, so a bare `!= nil` check would misclassify
     /// an explicit-null field as active.
     static func isActiveJSONValue(_ value: MacProviderCore.JSONValue?) -> Bool {
         guard let value else { return false }

     }
 
     /// True when logprobs are actually requested. Absent, null, or `false` are not

     static func isRequestedLogprobs(_ value: MacProviderCore.JSONValue?) -> Bool {

         default:

     private func applyContinuousBatchingPolicy(
         request: ChatCompletionRequest,
         snapshot: RuntimeSnapshot,
         emitTelemetry: Bool = true
     ) throws -> ContinuousBatchingCapability {
         let capability = continuousBatchingCapability(
             draftConfigured: snapshot.hasTargetCompatibleDraft || currentDraftModelID != nil,
             requestHasStableRequestID: Self.requestHasStableRequestID(request),
             requestStateRepresentable: Self.requestStateRepresentable(request)
         )
         // Telemetry is emitted once per request at preflight; execution paths
         // re-validate for fail-closed safety but must not re-log the same
         // serial-route event (avoids double-counting canary promotion evidence).
         if emitTelemetry {
             ContinuousBatchingPolicy.logSerialRouteIfNeeded(capability)
         }
         try ContinuousBatchingPolicy.validateStrictStartup(capability)
         return capability
     }

         maxContextTokens
     }

             while Date() < deadline {

  7015	    private static func harmonyParsedOutput(
  7016	        from parsed: HarmonyResponseParser.ParseResult,
  7017	        decode: ([Int]) -> String,
  7018	        stopTokenFilter: StopTokenFilter,
  7019	        requestStops: [String],
  7020	        globalHitStop: Bool = false,
  7021	        countCompletionTokens: Bool,
  7022	        generatedCompletionTokens: Int = 0
  7023	    ) throws -> ParsedGeneratedOutput {
  7024	        guard parsed.status != .malformed, parsed.status != .notApplicable else {
  7025	            throw harmonyResponseError(for: parsed.failure)
  7026	        }
  7027	        let filteredVisible = applyOutputFilters(
  7028	            parsed.content ?? "",
  7029	            stopTokenFilter: stopTokenFilter,
  7030	            requestStops: requestStops
  7031	        )
  7032	        guard !globalHitStop || filteredVisible.hitStop else {
  7033	            throw malformedHarmonyResponseError()
  7034	        }
  7035	        let toolCalls = filteredVisible.hitStop ? [] : parsed.toolCalls
  7036	        let hasToolCalls = !toolCalls.isEmpty
  7037	        let visibleContent = hasToolCalls ? "" : filteredVisible.text
  7038	        return ParsedGeneratedOutput(
  7039	            content: visibleContent,
  7040	            toolCalls: toolCalls,
  7041	            completionTokens: countCompletionTokens ? harmonyVisibleFinalTokenCount(
  7042	                tokenIDs: parsed.finalContentTokenIDs,
  7043	                parsedContent: parsed.content ?? "",
  7044	                visibleText: visibleContent,
  7045	                decode: decode
  7046	            ) : 0,
  7047	            generatedCompletionTokens: generatedCompletionTokens,
  7048	            hitStop: filteredVisible.hitStop,
  7049	            isTerminal: parsed.status == .parsed
  7050	        )
  7051	    }

  7053	    private static func harmonyVisibleFinalTokenCount(
  7054	        tokenIDs: [Int],
  7055	        parsedContent: String,
  7056	        visibleText: String,
  7057	        decode: ([Int]) -> String
  7058	    ) -> Int {
  7059	        guard !visibleText.isEmpty, !tokenIDs.isEmpty else { return 0 }
  7060	        guard visibleText != parsedContent else { return tokenIDs.count }
  7061	        for count in 1 ... tokenIDs.count {
  7062	            let prefix = decode(Array(tokenIDs.prefix(count)))
  7063	            if prefix == visibleText || prefix.hasPrefix(visibleText) {
  7064	                return count
  7065	            }
  7066	            if !visibleText.hasPrefix(prefix) {
  7067	                return max(0, count - 1)
  7068	            }
  7069	        }
  7070	        return tokenIDs.count
  7071	    }

  7207	        case .text:

  7225	                    inferenceRan: true,

The main code paths are now mapped. A key performance distinction is emerging: ordinary live scheduler delivery is one token per event, so the prior serial batch stream already decoded a full prefix once per token; the new per-token loop adds work mainly for replay events, while the new canonical tool-stop pass adds a second prefix-decode scan for tool rows. I’m checking exact tests and old/new control flow before classifying that impact.

    Preserve serial completion boundaries across batched replays
    
    Constraint: SPEC-038 v0.2.11 AC-6c requires batched rows to reuse serial finalization semantics.
    Rejected: Per-waiter replay observers | delivery chunking cannot define billing or cache settlement.
    Confidence: high
    Scope-risk: narrow
    Directive: Keep tool-stop billing boundaries derived from canonical row tokens.
    Tested: swift build; focused 210-test gate; revert proofs for finish reason and replay truncation.
    Not-tested: Full Swift suite remains red in this environment (3538 tests, 71 skipped, 198 failures); an observed reconnect timing failure passed in isolation.

     func testSerialToolTurnTruncatesToSerialStopAndMatchesSerialToolCalls() throws {
         let request = try request(["tools": Self.weatherTool])
         let vocab = Vocab(pieces: Self.twoCallPieces)
         let serial = try serialComplete(request, vocab: vocab)
         XCTAssertLessThan(serial.tokenCount, vocab.pieces.count, "serial stops at the first complete call")
 
         // The batched row's sink runs the serial stop test on each token.
         let stop = ModelRuntime.ContinuousBatchSerialToolStopState(request: request)
         var stopRequests = 0
         for id in vocab.ids where stop.observe(
             eventTokens: [id],
             decode: vocab.decode,
             stopTokenFilter: Self.stopTokenFilter,
             requestStops: request.stop
         ) {
             stopRequests += 1
         }
         XCTAssertEqual(stopRequests, 1)
         XCTAssertEqual(stop.stopTokenCount, serial.tokenCount)
 
         // The row decoded every token before stopping; the finalize truncates.
         let batched = try finalizeBatched(
             request,
             vocab: vocab,
             ids: vocab.ids,
-            serialStopTokenCount: stop.stopTokenCount,
             status: .length
         )
         let completion = try ModelRuntime.validateStructuredCompletion(batched.completion, request: request)
         XCTAssertEqual(calls(completion.toolCalls), calls(serial.completion.toolCalls))
         XCTAssertEqual(calls(completion.toolCalls), [#"get_weather {"city":"Paris"}"#])
         XCTAssertEqual(completion.finishReason, "tool_calls")
         XCTAssertEqual(completion.content, serial.completion.content)
         XCTAssertEqual(completion.completionTokens, serial.completion.completionTokens)
         XCTAssertEqual(completion.completionTokens, serial.tokenCount)
         XCTAssertEqual(batched.generatedTokens, Array(vocab.ids.prefix(serial.tokenCount)))
         XCTAssertTrue(batched.truncatedAtSerialStop, "a row past the stop point must not commit its cache")
     }

     func testStreamingOversizedToolArgumentsStreamNothingLikeSerial() throws {

     func testStreamingInvalidJSONUnderJSONSchemaMatchesSerialChunksAndError() throws {
         let request = try request(["response_format": Self.schema])
         // The trailing "<" is held back as a possible stop-token prefix and
         // only sent by the stream's end, before the structured verdict.
         let vocab = Vocab(pieces: ["{\"a\"", ": 1}", "<"])
         let serial = serialStream(request, vocab: vocab)
         let batched = batchedStream(request, vocab: vocab)
         XCTAssertEqual(batched.chunks, serial.chunks)
         XCTAssertEqual(batched.chunks, ["content:{\"a\"", "content:: 1}", "content:<"])
         guard case .failure(let serialError) = serial.result,
               case .failure(let batchedError) = batched.result else {
             return XCTFail("both paths must reject invalid JSON: \(serial.result) \(batched.result)")
         }
         XCTAssertEqual(batchedError.code, serialError.code)
         XCTAssertEqual(batchedError.status, serialError.status)
     }

+**Change log v0.2.11 (2026-09-25, tool-bearing and structured-output rows):**

+

 describes the decode hop as the implementation runs it. One hop advances every
 active decode row by a bounded window of W tokens, applying sampling, stop and
 emission to each token in order. W is at most the lockstep window (16 in
 production) and is capped by each row's remaining output budget.
 
 - W is 1 whenever a request waits for a free slot or is being admitted, so it
   joins at the next hop boundary.
 - While a prompt is mid-prefill and nothing else waits to join, W is at most
   the prefill decode window (8 in production). The rule was one token per
   prefill chunk, which left active rows at about 0.6 tok/s behind a long
   prompt on the M3 Ultra, because a 512-token chunk costs about as much as
   30–50 decode steps.
 
 Prefill evaluates only the caches, never the vocabulary projection, because
 prefill never samples.

 is satisfied per tuple and per runtime revision. The FR-CB10 accepted-tuple
 entry gains an optional boolean `cached_turns_accepted` (default false). A

I’m doing the final line-number/status check now.

codex
Result: one MEDIUM performance finding; no CRITICAL, HIGH, or correctness MEDIUM findings.

Verified:

- `ContinuousBatchToolStructuredRowTests`: 12/12 passed.
- Routing and scheduler regression tests: 2/2 passed.
- R1 implicit-context `finish_reason` fix is correct at `ModelRuntime.swift:4175-4182`.
- Canonical replay/duplicate tool-stop truncation is correctly applied before usage, billing, and cache settlement at `ModelRuntime.swift:4138-4157`.
- Serial behavior after `SerialStreamingTextEmitter` extraction matches the pre-change path.
- `git diff --check` is clean.
- The full suite was started but interrupted during an environment-heavy run; it is not claimed as passing.

Finding:

### MEDIUM — repeated prefix detokenization creates avoidable O(n²) work

Locations: `ModelRuntime.swift:4103-4108`, `4138-4143`, `3952-3957`, `4660`, `4706-4708`.

`continuousBatchSerialToolStopTokenCount` decodes every generated prefix again during finalization. The streaming row has already decoded each prefix while emitting tokens. If decoding is linear in prefix length, this adds O(n²) detokenization/parser work for a valid long tool-call argument stream, potentially causing material latency and reducing throughput.

`AttachedPagedKVStreamState.step` is also used for plain batched streaming rows because the state is created unconditionally. Normal live delivery remains one token per event and had the same full-prefix behavior before this change, so that is not a new regression. However, duplicate/terminal replay events contain the entire token list; the new loop decodes every replay prefix, whereas the previous path decoded the replay once. That is a new O(n²) replay cost and applies to plain rows too.

Fix: compute the canonical row-level tool-stop boundary once and carry it through the scheduler result/shared row state for finalization and replay settlement. Replace repeated full-prefix decoding with incremental detokenization and stateful tool/stop parsing, preserving the canonical boundary independently of individual waiters.

VERDICT: FAIL (0/0/1)
